predecessors.name: Ottoman Empire
predecessors.text: the principality between the Danube and the Stara Planina range, including Sofia, created by the Treaty of Berlin (13 July 1878)

successors.name: People's Republic of Bulgaria
successors.text: Bulgaria within its post-1940 borders (Southern Dobruja kept, Greek and Yugoslav lands renounced) when 'Monarchy abolished: 15 September 1946'

rulers.name: Regency (Stefan Stambolov, Sava Mutkurov, Petko Karavelov)
rulers.title: Regents

ledger.x: 1878: the Treaty of Berlin creates the Principality of Bulgaria, an Ottoman vassal.
ledger.cpn: Ottoman Empire

ledger.x: 1878: the principality is created as an Ottoman tributary state.
ledger.cpn: Ottoman Empire

ledger.x: 1885: Bulgaria and Eastern Rumelia unite.
ledger.cpn: Eastern Rumelia

ledger.x: 1885: Serbia attacks Bulgaria over the union.
ledger.cpn: Serbia (Revolutionary Serbia, Principality and Kingdom of Serbia)

ledger.x: 1886: the Treaty of Bucharest ends the Serbo-Bulgarian War with no change of border.
ledger.cpn: Serbia (Revolutionary Serbia, Principality and Kingdom of Serbia)

ledger.x: 1908: Ferdinand proclaims the independent Tsardom of Bulgaria at Veliko Tarnovo.
1908: Bulgaria declares independence and the Ottoman suzerainty ends.
ledger.cpn: Ottoman Empire

ledger.x: 1912: Bulgaria joins the First Balkan War and its armies enter Thrace and Macedonia.
ledger.cpn: Ottoman Empire

ledger.x: 1913: the Treaty of London cedes the Ottoman lands to the Balkan League; Bulgaria keeps western Thrace and part of Macedonia.
ledger.cpn: Ottoman Empire

ledger.x: 1913: Bulgaria attacks Serbia and Greece, opening the Second Balkan War.
ledger.cpn: Serbia (Revolutionary Serbia, Principality and Kingdom of Serbia)

ledger.x: 1913: Bulgaria and Greece fight over Aegean Macedonia in the Second Balkan War.
ledger.cpn: Greece (First Hellenic Republic, Kingdom of Greece, Second Hellenic Republic)

ledger.x: 1913: Romania invades Bulgaria.
ledger.cpn: United Principalities of Moldavia and Wallachia (Principality and Kingdom of Romania to 1918)

ledger.x: 1913: the Treaty of Bucharest ends the Second Balkan War.
ledger.cpn: Serbia (Revolutionary Serbia, Principality and Kingdom of Serbia)

ledger.x: 1913: Bulgaria gives up Kavala and Eastern Macedonia to Greece.
ledger.cpn: Greece (First Hellenic Republic, Kingdom of Greece, Second Hellenic Republic)

ledger.x: 1913: Bulgaria and Greece stop fighting at Bucharest.
ledger.cpn: Greece (First Hellenic Republic, Kingdom of Greece, Second Hellenic Republic)

ledger.x: 1913: Romania takes Southern Dobruja.
ledger.cpn: United Principalities of Moldavia and Wallachia (Principality and Kingdom of Romania to 1918)

ledger.x: 1913: the Dobruja war with Romania ends at Bucharest on 10 August 1913.
ledger.cpn: United Principalities of Moldavia and Wallachia (Principality and Kingdom of Romania to 1918)

ledger.x: 1913: Lozengrad, Lyule Burgas and Adrianople go back to the Ottomans.
ledger.cpn: Ottoman Empire

ledger.x: 1913: the Bulgarian-Ottoman contest over Thrace ends with the Treaty of Constantinople on 30 September 1913.
ledger.cpn: Ottoman Empire

ledger.x: 1915: an Ottoman-Bulgarian agreement hands Bulgaria the Ottoman land west of the Maritsa.
ledger.cpn: Ottoman Empire

ledger.x: 1915: Bulgaria enters the war and its armies occupy Serbian Macedonia and the Morava.
ledger.cpn: Serbia (Revolutionary Serbia, Principality and Kingdom of Serbia)

ledger.x: 1916: Bulgarian troops advance into Greek Eastern Macedonia.
ledger.cpn: Greece (First Hellenic Republic, Kingdom of Greece, Second Hellenic Republic)

ledger.x: 1916: Bulgaria seizes Dobruja from Romania.
ledger.cpn: United Principalities of Moldavia and Wallachia (Principality and Kingdom of Romania to 1918)

ledger.x: 1918: the Treaty of Bucharest gives Bulgaria Southern Dobruja and the south of Northern Dobruja.
ledger.cpn: United Principalities of Moldavia and Wallachia (Principality and Kingdom of Romania to 1918)

ledger.x: 1918: Bulgaria asks for an armistice and gives up the occupied Serbian lands.
ledger.cpn: Serbia (Revolutionary Serbia, Principality and Kingdom of Serbia)

ledger.x: 1918: the armistice orders Bulgaria out of Greek territory.
ledger.cpn: Greece (First Hellenic Republic, Kingdom of Greece, Second Hellenic Republic)

ledger.x: 1919: Bulgaria gives up Dobruja at Neuilly.
ledger.cpn: United Principalities of Moldavia and Wallachia (Principality and Kingdom of Romania to 1918)

ledger.x: 1919: the Treaty of Neuilly takes Western Thrace and the Aegean coast from Bulgaria.
ledger.cpn: Greece (First Hellenic Republic, Kingdom of Greece, Second Hellenic Republic)

ledger.x: 1919: the strip on the east bank of the Maritsa goes back at Neuilly.
ledger.cpn: Ottoman Empire

ledger.x: 1919: the Treaty of Neuilly takes border lands from Bulgaria for Yugoslavia.
ledger.cpn: Kingdom of Yugoslavia (Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes)

ledger.x: 1919: Southern Dobruja is returned to Romania at Neuilly.
ledger.cpn: Kingdom of Romania (Greater Romania)

ledger.x: 1940: the Treaty of Craiova gives Southern Dobruja back to Bulgaria.
ledger.cpn: Kingdom of Romania (Greater Romania)

ledger.x: 1941: Bulgaria occupies Greek Thrace and Eastern Macedonia.
ledger.cpn: Greece (First Hellenic Republic, Kingdom of Greece, Second Hellenic Republic)

ledger.x: 1941: Bulgaria occupies Yugoslav Macedonia and Pirot.
ledger.cpn: Kingdom of Yugoslavia (Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes)

ledger.x: 1943: the Bulgarian occupation zone in Greece is enlarged (bridging a silence).
ledger.cpn: Greece (First Hellenic Republic, Kingdom of Greece, Second Hellenic Republic)

ledger.x: 1943: the Bulgarian occupation zone in Yugoslavia is enlarged (bridging a silence).
ledger.cpn: Kingdom of Yugoslavia (Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes)

ledger.x: 1944: Bulgaria leaves Greek Thrace and Macedonia.
ledger.cpn: Greece (First Hellenic Republic, Kingdom of Greece, Second Hellenic Republic)

ledger.x: 1944: Bulgaria leaves the Greek land it held from 1943.
ledger.cpn: Greece (First Hellenic Republic, Kingdom of Greece, Second Hellenic Republic)

ledger.x: 1944: Bulgaria leaves Yugoslav Macedonia and Pirot.
ledger.cpn: Kingdom of Yugoslavia (Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes)

ledger.x: 1944: Bulgaria leaves the Yugoslav land it held from 1943.
ledger.cpn: Kingdom of Yugoslavia (Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes)

ledger.x: 1946: the monarchy is abolished and Bulgaria becomes a republic.
ledger.cpn: People's Republic of Bulgaria

wars.name: Serbo-Bulgarian War
wars.outcome: Bulgarian victory at Slivnitsa; ceasefire signed on 28 November 1885 and the Treaty of Bucharest of 3 March 1886 made 'no changes ... along the Bulgarian-Serbian border, preserving the unification of Bulgaria'.

wars.name: First Balkan War
wars.outcome: The Balkan League wins; the Treaty of London of 30 May 1913 cedes the Ottoman land west of the Enos-Midiya line to the League and leaves its division undecided.

wars.name: Second Balkan War
wars.outcome: Bulgaria loses: the Treaty of Bucharest (10 August 1913) leaves it Strumnitza and western Thrace, gives Kavala to Greece and Southern Dobruja to Romania; the Treaty of Constantinople (30 September 1913) returns Lozengrad, Lyule Burgas and Adrianople to the…

wars.name: Bulgaria in World War I
wars.outcome: Bulgaria joins the Central Powers (alliance 6 September 1915, war on Serbia 14 October 1915), takes Serbian Macedonia and the Morava in 1915 and Dobruja in September 1916, and asks for an armistice after the Vardar Offensive (effective 30 September 1918); the…

wars.name: Bulgaria in the Axis occupation of Yugoslavia and Greece
wars.outcome: 'When Yugoslavia and Greece were defeated, Bulgaria was allowed to occupy all of Greek Thrace and most of Macedonia'; Bulgaria left the war in August 1944 (Soviet declaration of war 8 September, coup 9 September 1944) and renounced all claims.
